mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, boosting corporate earnings and positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where real GDP growth increased over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months signals an improving labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.5% within three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals increased economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to reduced economic activity and negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where housing starts decreased by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over two months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, leading to increased costs and reduced corporate earnings, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the federal funds rate is above 2% and the consumer price index increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to reduced economic activity and negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where real GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.5% in a month.
